hero_kpi_rationale: Adjusted ROE target of 15-17%, reflecting MetLife's commitment to generating attractive shareholder returns while maintaining a global expansion strategy and all-weather performance
company_description: MetLife, Inc., a financial services company, provides insurance, annuities, employee benefits, and asset management services worldwide. It operates in six segments: Group Benefits; Retirement and Income Solutions; Asia; Latin America; Europe, the Middle East and Africa; and MetLife Holdings. The company offers life, dental, group short-and long-term disability, paid family and medical leave, individual disability, accidental death and dismemberment, accident and health, vision, and pet insurance, as well as prepaid legal plans; administrative services-only arrangements to employers; and general and separate account, and synthetic guaranteed interest contracts, as well as private floating rate funding agreements. It also provides pension risk transfers, institutional income annuities, structured settlements, and capital markets investment products; and other products and services, such as life insurance products and funding agreements for funding postretirement benefits, as well as company, bank, or trust-owned life insurance used to finance nonqualified benefit programs for executives. risks.title: Economic and Capital Markets Risks
risks.summary: Economic and market factors represent a significant risk that could affect MetLife's results due to its global presence and large investment portfolio
risks.score_rationale: Market factors including interest rates, credit spreads, equity and bond market declines, derivative prices, real estate conditions, exchange rates, and consumer and government spending could reduce revenue growth, investment opportunities and returns (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Interest Rate Risks
risks.summary: Changes in U.S. interest rates could materially impact investment returns, policyholder liabilities and overall profitability
risks.score_rationale: Interest rates are a key driver of MetLife's results, affecting guaranteed cash flow margins, investment returns, reinvestments, liability reserves and derivative cash flows (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Inflation Risks
risks.summary: Prolonged high inflation could affect financial markets and the broader economy, constraining revenue growth and investment opportunities
risks.score_rationale: Inflation can increase premiums in group insurance businesses, raise labor expenses, affect financial markets, and require adjustments to policyholder credit rates (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Credit and Counterparty Risks
risks.summary: Credit and counterparty risks increase in uncertain economic environments and could reduce investment values
risks.score_rationale: Counterparty defaults, financial institution failures and credit spread changes could negatively impact investments and derivatives (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Equity Market Risks
risks.summary: Equity market declines could reduce asset management fees and affect the performance of market-linked products
risks.score_rationale: Equity market changes affect the value of assets under management in the asset management business and impact returns on certain insurance products (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Liquidity and Funding Risks
risks.summary: MetLife relies on liquid capital markets; any disruption could affect its ability to fund operations and shareholder distributions
risks.score_rationale: Difficulties accessing funding or events affecting market liquidity could compromise MetLife's ability to meet its obligations and financial covenants (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risks
risks.summary: MetLife's global presence exposes it to foreign exchange risks, particularly in Asia, Latin America and Europe
risks.score_rationale: MetLife operates in numerous countries; exchange rate fluctuations could affect the value of assets under management, foreign investments and converted revenues (default score, to be refined)
